description: This is a Java integration test class for the Learning Management System (LMS) backend, specifically testing LMS flow scenarios such as course assignment submission and grade handling. It uses Spring Boot testing annotations, MockMvc for HTTP request simulation, and Jackson ObjectMapper for JSON serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: LmsFlowIT
